title: DSAQuant: Denoising-Stage-Aligned Quantization-Aware Training for Video Generation
code_status: Official Apache-2.0 repository provides inference/runtime, checkpoint export, and latency evaluation but no training code, infrastructure, or training data. Apache-2.0 packed W4A4 inference checkpoints are publicly available at https://huggingface.co/Robbyant-Research/DSAQuant.
